summary: RenewCrewLease answer in the backend model's shape. hostToken is present only when a new one was minted. renewInSeconds says when to call next.

provisional.why: awsJson1_0 per the backend model. That the server routes on X-Amz-Target at POST / is pending the backend team, contract section 13 item 18.
Epoch seconds, the awsJson1_0 default. Clients also accept ISO 8601 UTC strings until the backend team confirms, contract section 13 item 19.

The model types hostUrl as an https URL. The Crew dials the same host, port and path as wss, and also accepts wss. A loopback hostUrl may use http or ws only when the configured backend endpoint is itself loopback, for local test relays. Pending the backend team, contract section 13 item 20.
Above 60 and below 120 seconds. The backend team sets the exact value. The examples use 90.
Per-stage settings. The examples use prod's fallback names.

planPosition: The Crew dials hostUrl from the answer. Its own setting is only for tests before the lease client exists.
The Crew never compares leaseExpiresAt or hostTokenExpiresAt with its own clock. It times calls from renewInSeconds.

fields.endpointId: Always. The model's EndpointId, ^[a-z2-7]{32}$, inside this contract's ^[a-z0-9]{20,63}$.
fields.hostUrl: Always. An https URL in the model. The Crew dials it as wss with the same host, port and path, accepts a wss URL as is, and refuses any other scheme. When the configured backend endpoint is itself loopback (127.0.0.1, ::1 or localhost), a loopback hostUrl may also use http or ws, for local test relays only. With any other backend endpoint it refuses those schemes, loopback included.
fields.crewUrl: Always. The Crew's own https origin.
fields.hostToken: Optional in the model, present when a new one was minted. This contract's default for when: the request had no leaseVersion, or the current one has less than the mint threshold left.
fields.hostTokenExpiresAt: Optional in the model. Expected with hostToken, as its exp. For display and logs only.
fields.leaseVersion: Always. The Crew sends it back on its next renewal.
fields.renewInSeconds: Always. About 60, minus a small random spread.
